snippet.title: RE/SUB - Official Reveal Trailer - Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the demo now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194870/RESUB/

Slide across boards and find the path to the goal — every tile you cross becomes a wall you can't pass through again. What starts on flat grids evolves into 3D cubes and 4D puzzles. 100+ levels across 8 worlds with teleporters, sticky tiles, keys, resets, and more. 

Music by @rhinobetatron2650 

https://resub.funperframe.com
